newsitem.title: USA: Oasis Residential gets lower interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Oasis Residential gets lower interest rate.

text.p: Oasis Residential Inc said Tuesday it has secured a lower interest rate on its $200 million revolving credit facility.
The new interest rate on the facility is London Interbank Offered Rate plus 125 basis points, a reduction of 25 basis points from the previous interest rate.

The company said in a statement that following its recent $150 million bond issue it has retired $53 million in mortgage debt and has used the rest of the net proceeds towards reducing the outstanding balance of the credit facility to about $81 million.
The company's bank facility is led by Wells Fargo Bank and co-managed by J. P. Morgan and Bank One.
Oasis is a real estate investment trust.
